name: Genius Hall VR
summary:
You arrive through a Greek temple suspended in the sky. Behind it, four marble wings and twenty rooms with no walls: from every one of them you watch the clouds go past below.

ANCIENT WORLDS · Buddha, Aristotle, Alexander, Archimedes and Nezahualcoyotl, the poet king of Texcoco.
THE REVOLUTION IN KNOWING · Gutenberg, Leonardo, Galileo, Newton and Franklin.
THE NINETEENTH CENTURY · Napoleon, Darwin, Ada Lovelace, Florence Nightingale and Pasteur.
THE MODERN ERA · Tesla, Marie Curie, Einstein, Turing and Job
